Rico Verhoeven: Could the kickboxing superstar step in to fight Deontay Wilder on the Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua bill?
Rico Verhoeven could potentially step in to fight Deontay Wilder on the undercard of Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua at the Principality Stadium in Cardiff on December 11; Cruiserweight star Jai Opetaia was originally due to box Wilder in a heavyweight contest but had to withdraw
Wednesday 18 November 2026 15:10, UK
Deontay Wilder is now looking for a new opponent for his fight on the Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua undercard.
Wilder was due to box Jai Opetaia at the Principality Stadium on December 11, but Opetaia had to withdraw from their heavyweight bout and will stay at cruiserweight.
Wilder will remain on the card but the race is on to select a new opponent for him.
Rico Verhoeven could be a viable candidate. A kickboxing superstar, earlier this year the Dutchman went straight into a world title fight with legendary Ukrainian Oleksandr Usyk.
Verhoeven performed surprisingly well in that WBC championship fight in Giza. Although he was stopped in the 11th round, he had looked to threaten a monumental upset.
The Dutchman is now considering his next move and his team didn't rule out stepping in for Opetaia to fight Wilder in December.
"Plenty of interesting things happening right now," Verhoeven's manager Karim Erja told Sky Sports.
"We're exploring some exciting options for Rico, but you know him, he's always up for a big fight.
"Let's see what happens in the coming few days."
